verdicts.reason: A reads left to right in clear zones: logo and eyebrow, then headline, body copy and CTA. Its flaws: the body copy is wrapped into a narrow 5-line column at near-illegible size, the CTA pill is tiny, the eyebrow sits under the logo far from the headline, and the overall look is dense. B shrinks the logo to a speck in an oversized white panel and runs the headline almost into the CTA pill, which is tiny and jammed into the top-right corner. Its 'Ships late June' text is as big as the button label and nearly touches 'Evenings', so the CTA is buried and the right side is cramped while the left is mostly empty.
